documents.title: The Toll-Book
documents.text:
SANDTHRONE TOLL - HIGH GATE
kept by the toll-master's hand

14th day. Salt-carter, two mules. 3 sovereigns. Paid.
15th day. Pilgrims, six, for the south. 1 sovereign each. Four paid; two held till paid.
17th day. Oakhaven run, by Khaven. Two, small. Received from our riders.
    Handed on at the gate to the Concord escort: four horse, one closed cart. Road to Argentis.
    TOLL: none. By Seeker's warrant. Captain has the paper.
18th day. Iron, four carts, north road. 12 sovereigns. Paid.
19th day. Goatherd. Took two goats.
documents.canonStatus: GAME-ONLY: the toll-book and its entries. Sandthrone tolls in the Peaks are canon (book1 ch.5).

documents.title: Under a Seeker's Seal
documents.text:
BY WARRANT OF THE HIGH COUNCIL
Seeker's Office, to the Sandthrone captain of the Peaks toll

The bearer's escort passes the gate without toll or search, with its cargo: resonance candidates, two, collected at Oakhaven by the Investigation Bureau. They are to reach Argentis sound. Damage to the cargo will come out of your Company's fee.

A third candidate (the miller's boy) follows by the next wagon. Pass it likewise.

On the third passing, send word down the east road to the Bureau's man at Oakhaven. The seed already lies in the village water. It is to be woken then, and not before.

- the Seeker's mark -
documents.canonStatus: CANON-EXPANDED: Seekers, the Investigation Bureau and the Void-Seed in Oakhaven's water are canon (book1 ch.4); the warrant and its wording are GAME-ONLY. Where the children are taken is left open.

documents.title: The Waystation Keeper's Last Page
documents.text:
Third day of the new masters on the gate. They want a toll off the waystation now. A toll on bread.

Fifth day. Paid it. Paid it again when a different one came asking.

Sixth day. Torches on the lower road. I've sent the pilgrims out by the goat path with what bread there was, and I'm putting this in the hearth where I put everything. If you're reading it, lay a stone for me on the cairn below the gate.

Grenna Holt, keeper.

documents.title: Six on the Goat Path
documents.text:
Pencilled very small on the back of a pilgrim's token:

Six of us out of the waystation by the goat path, the night the torches came up the road. Grenna gave us the bread and would not come. She said someone had to keep the hearth lit, or they'd know.
Cold here. No fire after dark; they would see it from the gate.
We go on over the top at first light, south, for the Archive.
If you find this, Grenna: we made it this far.
documents.canonStatus: GAME-ONLY: the pilgrims and their camp. The Archive of Silence in the south is CANON (world_bible.md).

documents.title: To Ysolde, by Any Caravan
documents.text:
To Ysolde at the Dry Wells, in the south, by any caravan:

Sister, the pay is good, as they promised, and the cold is worse than they said. Snow in the middle of summer. They have us stopping carts on a mountain road and taking what we like and calling it toll, and most of the lads like it well enough.
I don't. Last week we passed two little ones through the gate in a closed cart, under a paper with a seal I'm not to speak of. No toll. They didn't cry. That was the worst of it.
When I've enough I'm coming home. Keep the goats.
Your brother, Tomas
documents.canonStatus: GAME-ONLY: the letter, Tomas and Ysolde. The Sandthrone is a CANON mercenary company; its toll in the Peaks is CANON (book1 ch.5).

documents.title: What the Jar Remembers
documents.text:
Unstopped, the jar gives back a voice, very far off, in no tongue you know, and yet you understand it:

'...and the river said its own name, and every stone in it answered, and that was the first song. We did not make it. We only learned to hum along. Remember that, when they tell you the Weave is theirs to spend...'

Then only the wind in the jar, and your own breath.
documents.canonStatus: CANON-EXPANDED: echo-jars, the Silent Pilgrims and the Original Song are CANON (world_bible.md); the words in this jar are GAME-ONLY.

documents.title: The Foreman's Notice
documents.text:
NOTICE. The Umbra working is closed by the foreman's order.

The deep level has gone bad. The stone down there is grey and smooth and does not ring under the pick. It makes no sound at all. Pell put his pick into it and drew it back without its point: not broken off, gone, clean, as if it had never had one.

We have walled the mouth with good mortar. Do not open it, for any price. The grey has got into the roots of the mountain.

- Bram Tolley, foreman
documents.canonStatus: CANON-EXPANDED: old mining tunnels under the Shattered Peaks (book2 ch.19) and the void slowly eating the Peaks' stone (world_bible.md) are CANON; the working, its foreman and this notice are GAME-ONLY.

quests.title: The Toll-Book
quests.canonStatus: CANON-EXPANDED: Sandthrone tolls in the Shattered Peaks are canon (book1 ch.5); the toll-book and the handover to a Concord escort are GAME-ONLY.
quests.summary: Fight through the Sandthrone toll-guards at the gate and take the toll-book from the strongbox by the toll-house.
quests.offer:
"Paid before they got here. Paid by whom?" Maddoc taps the page. "The Sandthrone write everything in their toll-book: who passed, what they paid, who paid it for them. They're proud of that book. They keep it in a strongbox by the toll-house, behind the gate."

"I can't ask pilgrims to fight for it. You aren't a pilgrim."
quests.complete: "Here." Maddoc's finger stops on the page. "'Two, small. Oakhaven run. Handed on at the gate to the Concord escort. Road to Argentis. No toll: by Seeker's warrant.'" He closes the book gently, as if it might wake. "A Seeker's warrant. That's the Council's own hand."

steps.text: Break the toll-guards at the gate.
Take the toll-book from the strongbox by the toll-house.

objectives.say: The strongbox lid gives with a crack. Coin, a knife, and a thick book bound in greasy hide.

steps.text: Bring the toll-book to Maddoc Vire.

objectives.say: "Let me see it." He wets a finger and turns the pages back a fortnight.

quests.title: Under a Seeker's Seal
quests.canonStatus: CANON-EXPANDED: Seekers and the Level 4 Void-Seed in Oakhaven's water are canon (book1 ch.4); the warrant, the captain and the Void-Seed's timing are GAME-ONLY. The children's fate is left open.
quests.summary: Take the Seeker's warrant from the Sandthrone captain in his eyrie above the toll gate, then show it to Tarsk the Ash-Walker.
quests.offer:
"'Captain has the paper.'" Maddoc says it twice. "The captain keeps the high camp above the gate, where he can watch the whole road. He's no toll-guard. He fights like the Peaks belong to him."

"If there's a warrant, it'll say where the children went, and why. Bring it back, and show it to Tarsk. He sits by my door and says nothing, but he reads, and he knows things about the grey I'd rather not."
quests.complete: "The children are gone up the road to Argentis. I know nothing that goes up that road and comes back." Tarsk taps the last lines of the warrant. "But this I know. A seed in your village water, waiting for a word. My people have seen what a seed does when it wakes."

steps.text: Take the Seeker's warrant from the Sandthrone captain above the toll gate.

objectives.say: Inside the captain's coat, in an oilcloth wrap: folded orders under a Seeker's seal, already broken.

steps.text: Show the warrant to Tarsk, the Ash-Walker scout at the rest.

objectives.say: Tarsk reads it once. Then he reads the last lines again, and lays his hand flat on the paper as if to hold something down.

quests.title: Salt of the First Sea
quests.canonStatus: CANON-EXPANDED: Mother Vane the Salt-Speaker, Salt of the First Sea and the enclave in the caves of the Eastern Ridge are canon (book1 ch.20); that salt can bind a Void-Seed is GAME-ONLY.
quests.summary: Follow the toll road down to the Ashland Rim and ask Mother Vane, the Ash-Walkers' Salt-Speaker, for salt to bind the seed in Oakhaven's well.
quests.offer:
"Salt binds what the grey unmakes. Not your kitchen salt. Salt of the First Sea, the old salt, spoken over by one who knows its words." Tarsk stands for the first time since you came. "Mother Vane knows them. Our enclave is in the caves of the Eastern Ridge, down the toll road where the land turns to ash."

"She won't give it to you. Salt is not given. But she may let you earn it."
quests.complete: Mother Vane hears you out without a word, turning a pinch of white salt between finger and thumb. "Aye. Salt of the First Sea will bind a seed. Bind it, mind. Not unmake it." She lets the salt fall. "And it's not given. It's earned."

steps.text: Follow the toll road down to the Ashland Rim.

objectives.text: Go down to the Ashland Rim
objectives.say: The toll road drops out of the Peaks onto a plain of grey ash. Nothing grows. Far to the east a ridge of dark rock stands against a bruised sky, and beyond it, the grey static of the Wasting.

steps.text: Find Mother Vane at the Ash-Walker enclave on the Eastern Ridge.

objectives.say: "Tarsk sent you. He sends me strays and expects me to feed them." Her eyes are blue and entirely too sharp. "A seed in a well. Hm. Sit down. Tell me all of it."

quests.title: Stones for the Lost
quests.canonStatus: GAME-ONLY (a burial custom of the pass)
quests.summary: Lay a stone on each of the three pilgrims' cairns along the toll road.
quests.offer:
"Every pilgrim who dies on this road gets a cairn, and every pilgrim who passes lays a stone on it. That's the custom." He looks at the empty benches. "Not many pass now. The cairns go bare, and the old folk say a bare cairn lets the dead wander."

"There are three along the road: one below, on the way up from Khaven, and two past the gate. A stone on each. Say their names if you know them. I don't, anymore."
quests.complete: "Good." Maddoc opens his book to a page of names and runs his thumb down it. "They'll rest a while longer."

steps.text: Lay a stone on each pilgrim cairn along the toll road.

quests.title: Wolves on the Mule Track
quests.summary: Cull six mountain wolves in the pines on the western slope.
quests.offer: "I've three mules left, and the wolves in the west pines have learned the sound of their bells." Yara slaps dust from her trader's coat. "Six of them. Enough that the rest learn a new sound."
quests.complete: "My mules will sleep tonight. So will I." She counts coin onto the stall without haggling, which for Yara is a kind of thanks.

steps.text: Cull the mountain wolves in the west pines.

quests.title: Rockhide
quests.summary: Bring Yara five rockhides from the boars in the wallow on the southern slopes.
quests.offer: "Rockhide boars. Skin like a scree slope, and it wears like one. Pilgrims' boots, mule harness, a Sandthrone jerkin if one comes asking." She grins. "Five hides. The boars wallow on the south slope, past the pines."
quests.complete: She bends a hide double; it barely creases. "That'll outlast us both."

steps.text: Take rockhides from the boars in the southern wallow.

quests.title: The Waystation Keeper
quests.summary: Search the ruined waystation on the lower road for its last keeper's journal.
quests.offer:
"Before the Sandthrone came there was a waystation on the lower road. Grenna Holt kept it. The toll-guards burned it the week they took the gate, and nobody ever found her."

"She kept a journal, like I keep my book. It'll be in the hearth if it's anywhere; she hid everything in the hearth. Bring it back. Someone should know how it ended."
quests.complete: Maddoc reads the last page twice, then closes the journal. "She got the pilgrims out by the goat path. That's like her." He sets it on the shelf beside his own book.

steps.text: Search the ruined waystation on the lower road.

objectives.say: Behind a loose hearthstone, wrapped in oilcloth: a soot-black journal. The last pages are written fast.

steps.text: Bring Grenna's journal to Maddoc Vire.

quests.title: The Dead-Drop
quests.summary: Hadrik Sull will pay well for the Salt-Menders' letters hidden in a waymarker on the eastern descent. Taking this contract costs you standing with the Salt-Menders.
quests.offer:
The broker doesn't get up. "Everyone who comes up this road ends up killing a few of my Company's people. I don't hold it against them. It's trade. Everything is."

"Here's another. The Salt-Menders run people over this pass under our noses, and they leave letters for each other in a hollow waymarker on the east road down. I want those letters. Bring them, and the Company forgets a few of its dead, and you walk away with more coin than the pilgrims will ever pay you."

"The Menders won't thank you. But then, they never pay."
quests.complete: Hadrik counts coin onto the bench, more than you've seen in one place since Oakhaven. "The Company remembers who it trades with. So do the Menders, I'm told. Choose your friends."

steps.text: Take the Salt-Menders' letters from the hollow waymarker on the eastern descent.
Bring the letters to Hadrik Sull.

objectives.text: Sell the letters to Hadrik Sull
objectives.say: "Ciphered in salt-marks. Of course." He smiles and pockets them. "We have people who read salt."

quests.title: What the Pale Ones Watch
quests.canonStatus: CANON-EXPANDED: the Pale Things as cosmic watchers are canon (world_bible.md); the watchers on the high ledge are GAME-ONLY.
quests.summary: Drive the Pale watchers off the high ledge above the east road, so Tarsk can see what they were watching.
quests.offer:
"Pale ones on the high ledge, above the east road. Three. They came when the escort went through, and they haven't moved since." Tarsk's voice is flat. "My people don't fight the Pale. We don't know that they can be fought. But you have a way of making things stop being where they stand."

"Make them stop. Then I'll go up and look at what they were looking at."
quests.complete: Tarsk comes down from the ledge an hour later and says nothing for a long time. "They were watching the road to Argentis," he says at last. "Not the road. What's at the end of it."

steps.text: Drive the Pale watchers off the high ledge.

quests.title: What the Mine Gave Back
quests.canonStatus: CANON creature (Hollow Men) and tunnels (book2 ch.19); GAME-ONLY quest
quests.summary: Hollow Men are walking out of the old mine west of the Rest. Look at the Sealed Adit, then put them down.
quests.offer: Maddoc keeps his book shut on his knee. "The old adit, west along the ore road. The Company bricked it up the year they took the gate. Said the tunnels ran too far east, under the grey." He looks at the window, not at you. "Something's come out of it anyway. Grey things, walking slow. Go and look at the bricks first. Then do what has to be done."
quests.complete: "Five." Maddoc opens the book and writes nothing in it. "They were miners once, likely. Somebody's sons." He closes it. "Don't tell me what the bricks looked like. I've an idea."

steps.text: Look at the Sealed Adit, at the end of the ore road.

objectives.say: The bricks across the adit are Company work, and the mortar is new. Near the bottom it has been scratched away in long grooves, from the inside, by something with more patience than strength.

steps.text: Put down the Hollow Men out of the adit.

quests.title: Shadows on the Cold Tarn
quests.summary: Pale shadows stand in the shallows of the Cold Tarn, north under the wall. Tarsk wants them gone.
quests.offer: Tarsk is sharpening nothing; the blade is already sharp. "The tarn. North, under the wall. Three shadows stand in the shallows at dusk, looking down." He tests the edge on his thumb. "The pale ones on the ledge look at the road. These look at the water. I don't know what's in the water. I'd rather they stopped."
quests.complete: Tarsk nods once. "Good." A long pause. "Did you look? In the water?" He doesn't wait for an answer. "No. Better not."

steps.text: Clear the pale shadows from the Cold Tarn.

objectives.say: The last shadow comes apart like breath on a cold morning, and the tarn is only water again.

quests.title: Grey Robes on the East Road
quests.summary: Men in pilgrims' grey are stopping carts at the Broken Post on the eastern descent. Hadrik wants them dead and their packs searched.
quests.offer: Hadrik turns a coin over his knuckles. "Pilgrims at the Broken Post. Grey robes, cairn-stones, very holy." The coin stops. "Pilgrims don't stop carts. These do, and the carts they stop are carts my gate let through. Somebody is selling the gate's tally. Kill the pilgrims, open their packs, and bring me the name of whoever is doing the selling. Same terms as before."
quests.complete: Hadrik reads the list twice, then folds it very small. "A Sandthrone hand. One of mine." He pays you without counting. "The Company is grateful. The Company is also going to be busy for a few days."

steps.text: Kill the false pilgrims at the Broken Post.
steps.say: Under the grey robes, Company mail.

steps.text: Search the false pilgrims' packs.

objectives.say: Cairn-stones for show, Company knives for use, and folded small in a boot a list of every cart the gate let through this month, in a Sandthrone hand.

quests.title: What the Shrine Hears
quests.canonStatus: GAME-ONLY (the Silent Pilgrims are CANON; this shrine is not theirs by any book)
quests.summary: Maddoc wants someone to stand at the Listening Shrine after dark and tell Tarsk what it says.
quests.offer: "There's a shrine up on the north spur. No idol in it. Just an ear, cut in the stone." Maddoc rubs his own ear without noticing. "The pilgrims used to stand there at night and listen. They'd come down quiet. Go up after dark and listen. Then tell Tarsk, not me. He'll know what it means. I'm too old to want to."
quests.complete: Tarsk listens without moving. "Numbers. The gate's numbers." He spits to one side. "The stone has been counting what goes through the pass. Or something is counting, and using the stone to say it." He looks east. "The pale ones count too."

steps.text: Stand at the Listening Shrine after dark.

objectives.text: Listen at the shrine at night
objectives.say: The wind goes through the cut ear in the stone and comes out as a voice, very low, saying numbers: carts and mules and heads, one by one, the toll-gate's tally read back to the dark.

steps.text: Tell Tarsk what the shrine said.

quests.title: The Thing Under the Umbra Scarp
quests.summary: One pale shape stands under the Umbra scarp west of the Rest, counting whoever passes. Yara's drovers won't go near it.
quests.offer: Yara is tallying her own stock and keeps losing count. "There's a thing under the Umbra scarp, west. Pale. It stands and it watches the goat path, and my drovers say it counts them as they go by. Out loud." She puts the slate down. "Three of them have quit. I can't buy what doesn't come up the path. Make it stop counting."
quests.complete: "It's gone?" Yara picks the slate back up. "Then they'll come back. Drovers always come back, for money." She marks something. "I'll not ask what it was. You'll not tell me. That's a fair trade."

steps.text: Kill the Umbra Watcher under the Umbra scarp.

objectives.say: It stops counting halfway through a number, and the scarp is very quiet.

quests.title: Bears in the High Pines
quests.summary: Mountain bears have come down into the high pines below the Cold Tarn, and they have taken two of the pilgrims' mules. Yara wants three of them dead.
quests.offer:
Yara Quell is mending a mule's harness that something has bitten clean through. "Bears. Grey ones, mountain bears, down in the high pines under the tarn." She holds up the harness. "Two mules this week. They don't come below the snow in a good year, and this isn't one."

"Three of them. Keep your back to a tree, and don't run: they're quicker than you downhill."
quests.complete: "Three." Yara turns a grey pelt over in her hands, thick as a blanket. "That's a winter's warmth for somebody up here." She folds it. "The mules will thank you. In their way."

steps.text: Kill the mountain bears in the high pines.
